versions.changelog:
- Initial release of prompt-optimizer skill with strict two-stage iterative optimization workflow.
- Implements ACON's (arXiv:2510.00615) input parsing, critical signal extraction, and compression methodology.
- Integrates APE (arXiv:2211.01910) automatic prompt engineering with multi-candidate generation and scoring.
- Supports multi-round optimization based on explicit user feedback, ensuring functional integrity at every step.
- Only activates when explicitly requested by the user and always preserves all critical signals and original task intent.
